spec_family.name: New Construction Interior Window Painting
spec_family.description: Combined prime+paint spec for interior window units in new construction. Covers 3 substrates (wood, aluminum, steel) with substrate-driven primer selection and QT-driven finish systems. Primer is conditional on substrate_state: SS_BARE requires primer, SS_PRIMED_FACTORY skips to finish coats. Uses EA as primary UOM with Size Bucket Method (S/M/L/O) for rate scaling. 5-tier height system (H1-H5). Window type and muntin modifiers. Glass masking mandatory regardless of method. Material systems are QT-driven recommendations — contractor retains discretion on product selection.

includes: Operable sash painting (double-hung, casement, slider, awning)
Substrate-specific preparation (wood sand/fill, aluminum degrease/etch, steel degrease/rust treatment)
Primer coat — conditional on substrate_state = SS_BARE or substrate = aluminum/steel
Finish coat application (brush or spray) — 2 coats standard, 3+ at QT5 brush/roll per FFD 15.10.3
Between-coat interstage process (inspect, sand, repair, clean) at ALL quality tiers
Glass masking (mandatory regardless of application method)
Hardware protection (remove or mask: locks, latches, crank operators)
Floor protection in window work area
Wall masking around window (spray, or brush when walls SS_PAINTED_*)
Sill/stool protection (spray when stool is SS_PAINTED_*)

excludes.item: Window casing (exterior trim around window opening)
Masking off finished windows for subsequent wall painting

excludes.route_to: Not painting scope — SDL grilles snapped out by installer

configuration_dimensions.description: Quality tier controlling inspection scrutiny, sanding discipline, repair scope, and coat count. Does NOT affect application quality (binary at all tiers). Does NOT drive primer selection (substrate-driven).
configuration_dimensions.notes: QT3=standard production. QT4=premium (full sand, systematic inspect). QT5=superior (thorough sand, critical inspect, 3+ coats brush/roll). Sheen/QT gate enforced at runtime.

configuration_dimensions.description: Primary application technique for primer and finish coats.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Brush is default for window detail work — 1.5-inch angled sash brush per Window_Systems_Doctrine Section 8.2.1. Spray available for high-volume NC production but requires extensive masking. QT5 gloss with brush is achievable — do NOT enforce spray.

configuration_dimensions.description: Finish sheen. Constrained by quality tier gate.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Default semi-gloss requires minimum QT4. If user selects QT3, semi-gloss is rejected and satin offered. Gloss is QT5 only.

configuration_dimensions.description: Window substrate material. Drives prep protocol and primer selection.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Vinyl excluded — separate specialty spec per user decision. Each substrate has fundamentally different prep and primer requirements per Window_Systems_Doctrine Sections 3, 6.

configuration_dimensions.description: Input substrate condition. Drives primer requirement and prep scope.
configuration_dimensions.notes: SS_BARE: full primer coat required, heavier prep (full sand, grain fill for wood; etch/DTM for metal). SS_PRIMED_FACTORY: skip primer, lighter prep (scuff sand only). Metal substrates always require primer regardless of state.

configuration_dimensions.description: Window operating type. Controls base production rate modifier.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Per Window_Systems_Doctrine Section 8.3. Double-hung is baseline (most common NC residential window). Fixed is simplest (no operable parts).

configuration_dimensions.description: True divided light (TDL) muntins present. Adds +20% labor to application and sanding tasks.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Per Window_Systems_Doctrine Section 8.3. Only applies to TDL. SDL grilles are removed before painting — no modifier.

configuration_dimensions.description: Window size category per PaintScope Size Bucket Method.
configuration_dimensions.notes: Per PaintScope_Window_Counting_System. S=~8 LF perimeter, M=~12 LF (baseline), L=~17 LF, O=measured perimeter. Modifiers are research estimates (production assumption A-001).

paintable_items.name: Window unit (frame, sash, muntins)
paintable_items.counting_rules: Count each window opening as one EA. Includes frame interior face, operable sash(es), and TDL muntins as a single assembly. Counted by size bucket (S/M/L/O) and height tier (H1-H5).
paintable_items.notes: Primary paintable item. EA-based with Size Bucket Method for rate scaling. Window type and muntin modifiers apply per window.

paintable_items.name: Extension jamb / reveal
paintable_items.counting_rules: Same count as ITM_WINDOW_UNIT — one extension jamb per window opening. May not be present on all windows (some have no extension jamb).
paintable_items.notes: Separate item because extension jamb may have different prep requirements (deeper reveal, different access angle). Same size bucket and height modifiers apply.

variants.notes: Bare substrate, standard brush production. Primer + 2 finish coats. Satin is the only sheen at QT3.
Bare substrate, premium brush. Primer + 2 finish coats. Semi-gloss typical at QT4.
Bare substrate, superior brush with gloss. Primer + 3 finish coats per FFD 15.10.3.
Factory-primed wood, standard brush. No primer — scuff sand then 2 finish coats. Most common NC scenario.
Factory-primed wood, premium brush. No primer — 2 finish coats.
Factory-primed wood, superior brush with gloss. 3 finish coats per FFD 15.10.3.
Factory-primed wood, standard spray. Full protection required. Fastest production.
Factory-primed wood, premium spray. Full protection.
Factory-primed wood, superior spray. QT5 spray uses 2 coats (not 3). Full protection.

application_method = spray AND floor_type = finished or partial

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Wall masking LF around window perimeter

required_paintscope_inputs.description: Sill edge masking LF during spray

protection_zones_required.notes: Runner-style drop cloths along window work perimeter. Brush method only. Excluded when floor is subfloor.
Radial floor protection around spray zone. 8 ft radius from each window. Replaces perimeter drops when spraying.

protection_zones_required.condition: ALWAYS — mandatory regardless of application method
protection_zones_required.notes: Paper/film masking on all window glass panes. Mandatory. 1/16-inch seal technique may apply for wood windows per Window_Systems_Doctrine Section 4.1.
Tape/bag or remove window hardware (locks, latches, crank operators). Removal preferred when feasible.
Wall masking around window perimeter for spray method. Also required for brush when walls are SS_PAINTED_* (finished).
Protect stool/sill from overspray. Only when stool is already finished (SS_PAINTED_*) by trim spec.

adjacent_surfaces.notes: Window frame meets wall at perimeter. Typical NC: walls at SS_PRIMED_FIELD — no wall protection for brush. Spray: always mask. When walls SS_PAINTED_*: mask for both methods. No edge work — protection only.
Window casing handled by SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT. Often same finish color/sheen. Casing-to-frame edge requires careful brush work but no separate edge task. Often painted in same session.
Stool handled by SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT / SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME as linear trim. Often same finish. When already finished, protect from overspray during spray window painting.
Glass is NOT painted. Glass masking is mandatory (protection zone). 1/16-inch seal technique creates intentional paint-to-glass seal for wood windows. Glass scraping/cleanup after cure.

valid_input_states.notes: Combined prime+paint spec. SS_BARE (bare wood, bare metal) requires full primer coat + heavier prep. SS_PRIMED_FACTORY (standard NC wood windows) requires scuff sand only — skip primer, go directly to finish coats. Metal substrates (aluminum, steel) always require primer regardless of state.

output_state.notes: Output state varies by sheen dimension. Semi-gloss is window default (requires QT4+).

adjacent_state_protection_rules.notes: When walls are finished (SS_PAINTED_*), wall masking around window required for BOTH spray and brush methods. Spray: tape + paper. Brush: tape only.
When walls are unfinished (typical NC), spray method still requires wall masking to prevent overspray.
When walls are unfinished and brush method, no wall protection needed. Typical NC scenario.
When stool is already finished by trim spec, protect from overspray during spray window painting.

site_condition_rules.effect: Floor protection excluded when floor is subfloor.
site_condition_rules.notes: NC often has subfloor during window painting. Finished/partial floors require drop cloth runners (brush) or full radial coverage (spray).

site_condition_rules.effect: Height modifier applies per 5-tier system: H1=1.00, H2=1.30, H3=1.50, H4=2.00, H5=2.50.
site_condition_rules.notes: Per Modifier_Registry v1.2. Height distribution captured by PS_OPENING_EA.WINDOW_H1-H5. Weighted average or per-window calculation.

site_condition_rules.effect: Lead-safe practices for sanding tasks. tested_positive=2.0x, unknown_pre1978=1.5x.
site_condition_rules.notes: Windows are HIGH-RISK for lead exposure — friction surfaces (sashes in frames) are major lead dust generators per Window_Systems_Doctrine Section 11. Rare in NC (post-1978). RRP protocol triggered.

site_condition_rules.effect: Temperature affects dry times, open time, and leveling. cold_below_50f=1.30x, hot_above_90f=1.15x.
site_condition_rules.notes: Critical for blocking prevention — windows must remain open during cure (3-7 days). Cold may extend cure time. NC sites may lack HVAC.

sequencing_notes.production_sequence: Window painting is part of the trim package in NC. Typical sequence: Prime ceilings → Prime walls → Finish ceilings → Trim/window package (prime → finish → mask off) → Wall finish. Pairs naturally with SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT for shared protection setup and same material system.
sequencing_notes.edge_work: No edge work in this spec. All adjacent surfaces are protection relationships only (masking), not cut-in. Window-to-glass interface is masking, not painting.
sequencing_notes.protection_sequence: Setup floor protection → Glass masking (mandatory) → Hardware protection → Wall masking (if applicable) → Sill protection (if applicable) → Apply coats → Teardown. Glass masking removed during glass scraping (cleanup), not during protection teardown.
sequencing_notes.coat_sequence: Prep (substrate-specific) → [Primer (conditional)] → [Interstage] → Finish coat 1 → Interstage → Finish coat 2 → [QT5 brush: Interstage → Finish coat 3] → Final inspect → Cleanup
sequencing_notes.blocking_prevention: All operable sashes must be painted in AJAR position. Do NOT close before full cure (3-7 days for enamels). Per Window_Systems_Doctrine Section 10.1.
sequencing_notes.glass_scraping_timing: Glass scraping occurs AFTER full cure (3-7 days), NOT between coats. May happen on a different day than other cleanup tasks.

relationships.notes: Window painting is part of the trim package in NC. Same crew, same material system, same session. Window casing and stool belong to SF_TRIM_NC_PAINT / SF_TRIM_NC_PRIME. Window masking for wall painting is SF_DRYWALL_WALL_NC_FINISH responsibility.

inherited_research_corrections.original_claim: Dry times should be specified in specs
inherited_research_corrections.corrected_to: No dry times in specs — refer to product PDS. Dry times vary by product, temperature, humidity.

inherited_research_corrections.original_claim: Material system selection is mandatory doctrine — QT drives material system
inherited_research_corrections.corrected_to: Material systems are suggestions per QT — contractor has discretion on product selection.

inherited_research_corrections.original_claim: Waterborne alkyds have longer open time
inherited_research_corrections.corrected_to: Both Advance (waterborne alkyd) and Emerald Urethane (acrylic-urethane enamel, NOT waterborne alkyd) have SHORT working times. Fast dry demands proper first-pass technique.

change_log.author: SpecFactory
change_log.changes: Initial draft spec for NC interior window painting (Spec #10 in Phase 1 catalog). Key features: combined prime+paint with conditional primer (substrate-driven primer, QT-driven finish), 3 substrates (wood, aluminum, steel — vinyl excluded per user decision), EA-based counting with Size Bucket Method (S/M/L/O), 5-tier height system (H1-H5 per Modifier_Registry v1.2), window type modifiers (DH/casement/slider/fixed/awning), muntin +20% modifier for TDL, glass masking mandatory at all methods, blocking prevention work practice, dual material system (4 primer + 3 finish systems), 29 SOP tasks across 8 modules, 3 round configurations, 6 protection zones. First combined prime+paint spec in the system.
